name: Monsoon Depression
description: Synoptic scale low pressure systems propagating along the monsoon trough, frequently causing widespread heavy to extremely heavy rainfall.

name: Heavy Rainfall
description: Mesoscale convective complexes and localized extreme precipitation events exceeding 115.6 mm / 24 hours.

name: Cyclone
description: Tropical cyclonic vortices over the Bay of Bengal or Arabian Sea with rapid intensification potential.

name: Western Disturbance
description: Extratropical storm systems originating in the Mediterranean that bring winter/pre-monsoon precipitation to north-western India.

name: Heat Wave
description: Prolonged periods of abnormally high temperatures, advecting dry air over central and northwestern India.

name: Active Monsoon
description: Periods of enhanced rainfall over the core monsoon zone with southward shift of the monsoon trough.

name: Break Monsoon
description: Migration of the monsoon trough to the Himalayan foothills leading to suppression of rain over central India and deluge along the foothills.
